sloka: औत्सुक्यं परमं चापि अधृतिश्च परा मम ।शून्यामेव च पश्यामि पृथिवीं पृथुलोचन ।। ७.४६.१५ ॥
transliteration: autsukyaṁ paramaṁ cāpi adhṛtiśca parā mama ।śūnyāmeva ca paśyāmi pṛthivīṁ pṛthulocana ।। 7.46.15 ॥

translations.english: I also have extreme anxiety and great restlessness, and indeed, O broad-eyed one, I see the earth as empty.
